---
title: "New lab website"
date: 2026-10-14
description: "The Sanner Lab has a new website, with downloads, documentation and tutorials for each of our software tools."
image: ../../images/social-card.jpg
---

The lab's new website is at [sannerlab.github.io](https://sannerlab.github.io). It brings
together:

- [a page for each of our software tools](../../software/index.qmd), with downloads,
  documentation, tutorials and a gallery. These pages used to be on ccsb.scripps.edu.
- the downloads themselves (installers, tutorial data and PDFs). They are now in the releases of
  [sannerlab/downloads](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases) on GitHub.
- the lab's [publications](../../publications.qmd).
- [who we are](../../lab.qmd): current members, alumni and funding.
